captions.detailed: This 3D model is a compact, functional filament clip designed to attach to a spool rim. It features a large U-shaped spring arm that clamps onto the spool edge, complete with inward-facing retaining bumps at the open tips to ensure a secure hold. Perpendicular to the main clamp is an integrated secondary clip with a circular cutout and a narrow entry slot, designed to firmly grip and park a loose end of 3D printing filament.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, 3D-printable filament clip in OpenSCAD that attaches to a spool rim while holding the loose filament end. Include adjustable parameters for the filament diameter, spool thickness, spool rim thickness, arm length, overall width, and wall thickness to ensure a perfect fit for various spool brands.
captions.factory: The script constructs the clip using a boolean difference of a unioned outer profile and subtracted inner cutouts. The main U-shaped clamp is formed by unioning two parallel cubes, a large cylinder at the closed end, and two smaller cylinders at the open tips to create the retaining bumps. A side block is unioned to the structure and then hollowed out using a cylinder and a cube to create the circular slot and entry channel for the filament, while the inner gap of the main clamp is cleared using a cylinder and a large rectangular cube.
